ph.aciklama_modeller: Textured, high-polygon models scanned from real objects or modelled by hand. The licence is CC0: they can be used freely, including in commercial projects. The model is downloaded, verified and placed on the plan; its size, angle and finish can be changed in the Properties panel.
ph.aciklama_dokular: Colour, normal and roughness maps captured from real surfaces (parquet, plaster, fabric, stone, brick…). The texture is applied at its real size; it is added as a finish and assigned to a room, wall or object with “Apply”.
ph.liste_alinamadi: The library list could not be loaded: {error}
ph.kaplama_ipucu: Assign it to a room, wall or object with “Apply”

boya.aciklama: Choose wall and facade paints by real colour codes. Picking a colour arms the paint tool: click any wall on the plan. To give one wall two colours and a stripe, select the wall and use the “Combined paint” section on the right.
boya.not_yaklasik: Colours on screen and in renders are approximate; compare with the manufacturer's physical colour card before buying paint. RAL Classic is built in. Add a paint brand's own palette (an ASE, GPL or CSV file published by the brand) with “Import brand palette”; it is saved in the project file.
boya.ilk_n_gosteriliyor: Showing the first {n} of {total} colours; search to narrow down.
boya.hazir_ipucu: Click the wall you want to paint on the plan.
boya.kombine_ipucu: Ready pairs set the upper colour and lower zone together. The lower zone runs on the inner face from the floor to the dividing height; the stripe sits just above that line.
